nom: Paula's Choice Hyaluronic Acid + Peptide Lip Booster

avis.texte: Pros: hydrating, non-tacky, no scent, not extremely glossy for men, gets rid of lip lines like the product said it would. Cons: so... If you eat or drink anything you'll have to reapply. Doesn't dry out lips or crust up but i do find myself reapplying maybe more often? Maybe bc I like the cooling sensation of the metal tip. Idk. It also costs a lot for a lip product but my lips have never looked healthier even when I'm not wearing it. I have purchased another tube already since I'm almost done with my first one.

avis.titre: Moisturizing, but no changes in lip volume
avis.texte: So I bought this based on a TikTok (I know) I saw of a supposed dermatologist saying this kind of lip balm can naturally plump lips. I wanted a new lip balm anyway, and decided to test it out. Bought this early February and wanted to wait to try it out. It’s now mid April. Used it 3x a day almost every day as instructed, and while my lips are definitely more moisturized, they haven’t changed otherwise. I was skeptical from the beginning, and am not too surprised it didn’t have a natural plumping effect from the hydration. Other than that, I give it 4/5 stars. I would give it 5, but when I put it on a little will make its way into my mouth and to the back of my throat, and it causes some irritation so I have to clear my throat because of that. There’s no smell, but I will warn it has a greasy feel. I don’t mind it but others might. It also gives a nice healthy shine and isn’t as sticky as lip glosses can be. Overall I recommend it if you want more hydration!

avis.titre: Perfectly lightweight and hydratingPerfectly lightweight and hydrating
avis.texte: Wow! I absolutely love this ! It’s super hydrating and not thick and smothering! Great for my dermatitis around my lips I put this on and top it off with my avene cicalfate lip cream. I love the thin consistency but it’s not too thin to where is evaporates it’s just right! I will be buying again.
Wonderful for dry lips, but kind of costly but still works good

avis.titre: Carmex Does More For LessCarmex Does More For Less
avis.texte: I bought this a few months ago to keep on my nightstand for use before bed. I'd heard peptide lip treatments could provide subtle plumping, though I wasn't expecting anything dramatic. Overall, it was fine -- nothing remarkable, but not bad either. I already knew I wouldn't repurchase it as it never felt particularly special. I'd already accepted I'd got got so I was going to take my $33 L in silence. But this past week of use pushed me to warn others who are thinking of treating their lips to an "upgrade". Galveston's high humidity usually keeps my lips in good shape, but we had one of those rare, cool, low-humidity days where my lips paid the price. I moved this from my nightstand to my purse, and I'm here to tell you: it does not travel well. Day 4 of continuous use, and the only thing hydrated is my purse. Save your $33 (don't even buy it on sale)! Stick to Carmex (which actually gives subtle, temporary plumping) or whatever inexpensive lip treatment that's been keeping you going all along. Carmex will clear up this crusty upper lip I've been rocking in less than 24 hours. Shame on me, shame on Paula. Photos to show off the sticky, dirty mess.

This lip booster is amazing! It makes my lips feel soft, smooth, and super hydrated without being sticky. I love the lightweight texture — it feels more like a nourishing treatment than a gloss. After using it consistently, my lips look plumper and healthier. A little goes a long way, and it’s perfect for both day and night. Definitely worth every penny!
I actually love this product. I even enjoy the cool, metal applicator. I’m seeing plumper lips already!!!! Very happy and will order more. 🩷🩷🩷

The applicator is great, and the product goes on easily and feels great. The downfall is that it last about 1 hour and it taste like rancid oil. Everytime inhale, I can taste the product at the back of my throat.

avis.titre: I wanted it to not work…
avis.texte: Because of the price point I was really hoping I wasn’t going to notice a difference or see more fullness in my lips, but I have. I use it pretty well every day and it’s been subtle but I’ve definitely noticed more plumpness in my lips, especially when I’ve applied a colour or gloss when going out. I can almost justify the price because I’m trying to avoid other types of lip “improvements.”

I am headed into my 50th trip around the sun and had started to see these small but deep lines around my lips. I was considering injections to get rid of them as they appeared even deeper when I put lipstick on. I bought this product and I have to say it is one of the best investments. The photo in the bottom right hand was when I started 2 weeks ago. The photo on top is this morning. I know this is a temp fix, but it is better than an injection. :)
I love this lip balm. Really moisturising and nourishing to your lips. I’ll definitely be buying it again!

i’m coming here to buy my second one & thought i’d leave a review especially since i’m someone who loves any lip oil/gloss/balm products so i’ve tried them all. my top 2 favs are this and summer fridays. so i definitely recommend it & the reason i love this one so much is it’s perfect for at night or when you’re at home & don’t really want color just something to keep your lips feeling smooth and hydrated, but also looks very glossy if you wanted to layer it over liner or wear out!! anyways it’s a holy grail for me.
I noticed the mointure immediately and provides lips glow. I'll definitely keep buying this stuff.

Tal como lo dice el titulo, yo noté resultados desde la primera aplicación. Es suave, sin olor y muy hidratante. Los beneficios del acido hialuronico están super activos, solía tener muchas líneas en mis labios, Parecidas a estrías, algunas de una intensidad notoria. En la actualidad cada vez se ven menos, desaparecen. Desde mi punto de vista esto era justo lo que mis labios caribeños necesitaban.
Very thin lips. And I’ve tried everything. This is my go-to now. Looks great AND feels great. Not sticky at all. You’ll wanna carry this around with you everywhere!
Spent a lot of money on this and it expires in about two months ….
Moisturizing with a cute metal applicator. My lips were chapped due to me over exfoliating and this helped peel the dead skin off within 2 days

I got the Paula's Choice BOOST Hyaluronic Acid + Peptide Lip Booster for my wife and she likes how it looks and feels on her lips. It comes in a small tube with a metal applicator for more precise application. It moisturizes and makes lips feel healthier and plumper. It has an interesting mix of hyaluronic acid, peptide and squalene along with a long list of other ingredients. Made in the USA ~ Kort

I’ve had chapped lips for the past year and I couldn’t find anything that will do it’s job. I use my chapstick every 30 min and it gets very annoying having to bring it everywhere. Somehow heard of this product and since it’s not as cheap as other chapsticks, I wanted to give it a try. The quality is very very bad. It’s got some chemical smell to it and when it gets in my mouth it makes my caught and I need to spit it out. Just stay away from it. I needed something that would do it’s job and make my life easier by not needing to bring a chapstick everywhere I go. Well at least I tried!

The lip balm has a very unpleasant smell, and the taste is also off-putting. I’m disappointed; I think it might be expired because it shouldn’t smell like spoiled cosmetics. Paula’s Choice products always have a nice scent. I’m forced to throw it away because I’m in a country where it takes a long time to return, and I can’t make it in time. I’m very, very disappointed.

avis.titre: It’s the metal applicator for me
avis.texte: I loved the metal applicator. It felt very nice on my lips as I was applying the lip treatment. The balm was not too thick nor too thin and it wasn’t sticky at all. It keeps my lips hydrated. I feel luxurious using this lip treatment. It contains hyaluronic acid and squalane that help smooth and plump the lips. This lip balm is definitely a splurge. You don’t get a lot for the cost of the product. For me, I’ll use it sparingly. Good stuff but pricey

avis.titre: Quickly works to slough off dead skin on lips.
avis.texte: This lip treatment product is pricey, but it works amazingly well. After just two applications, the dead skin on my lips started sloughing off to reveal smooth skin. I like how quickly this works to transform the appearance and condition of my lips. It is very moisturizing and fragrance free. I like the metal applicator tip because it feels cool and soothing on my lips. Because this lip treatment product works so well, it is worth the splurge if you have very dry lips that need exfoliation.
